title: Cuban Marinated Steak
description: Rib eye steaks marinate in orange juice, toasted cumin seeds, and a few other seasonings before hitting the grill briefly for delicious, flavorful seared meat.

steps.text: Heat cumin seeds in a small skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until seeds turn dark brown and smell toasted, about 1 minute. Immediately pour seeds into a bowl to stop the cooking. Stir in orange juice, vegetable oil, steak seasoning, lime juice, and oregano.

Place steaks into a large resealable plastic bag; pour in orange juice marinade. Squeeze out air, seal bag, turn it over several times until steaks coated. Marinate in the refrigerator at least 30 minutes, or longer for extra flavor.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Remove steaks from marinade and shake off excess. Discard remaining marinade.

Grill steaks on the preheated grill until seared on the outsides and still slightly pink in the centers, 6 to 8 minutes per side. An instant-read meat thermometer inserted sideways into the center of the thickest steak should read 145 degrees F (65 degrees C). Let steaks rest for 3 minutes before slicing.

video.description: Make it a dinner to impress with tasty Latin-inspired steak. First whip up a quick toasted cumin and citrusy marinade. Then let your rib eye steaks settle in to draw in all the spice and flavors. Grilled up right, these steaks are tempting, juicy and delicious. Serve with spicy black beans, rice and plantains and garnish with lime wedges for extra kick.
